text: Architected a Java calendar application using MVC architecture with Observer and Adapter design patterns, supporting GUI (Java Swing), CLI, and headless modes through a unified controller
Engineered multi-calendar management with IANA timezone support, recurring event scheduling, conflict detection, and CSV import/export compatible with Google Calendar
Validated functionality through 450+ JUnit test cases, achieving 89% mutation coverage and 85%+ line coverage, with CI/CD automated via GitHub Actions, Maven, and JaCoCo
